intro: Where Persona's data comes from, and what it can act on for you. The assistant, AI twin, and agents use these to check your calendar, read messages, and send email, and they ask you before acting on your behalf. This iPhone (contacts, calendar, reminders, photos, health, location) is only available in the phone app, not on the web.
mail_footer: Accounts live on the hub. Passwords are stored encrypted and never sent back. The Inbox, assistant, and AI twin share them. You can also just tell Persona "add my email account."
gmail_body: Gmail uses Sign in with Google, not a password. After you authorize, Google returns to the Persona app on your iPhone, which the web can't receive. On your phone, open Settings › Connectors › Mail › Add account › Gmail. Once it's added, it shows up here and in the Inbox.
gmail_not_configured_title: This hub isn't set up for Google sign-in
gmail_not_configured_body: Once an admin adds google.client_id to the assistant's manager.json and restarts the hub, the phone app can sign in with Google (a one-time setup). Until then, add Gmail with an app password.
gmail_app_password_hint: Turn on 2-Step Verification for the Google account, then create a 16-character password under Google Account › Security › App passwords and enter it here (not your Google password).
lark_hint: Lark Mail: the servers are always imap.larkoffice.com:993 and smtp.larkoffice.com:465 (SSL), so just enter your address and password. Use the third-party client password from Lark Mail settings.
imap_hint: QQ, 163, iCloud, and others fill in the servers from the domain. Chinese providers usually need an app password (授权码) rather than your sign-in password. For Outlook, pick Outlook above.
qq_code_steps: Servers fill in automatically. The password is an authorization code (授权码), not your QQ password: open QQ Mail on the web, go to Settings › Account & Security › Security Settings, turn on “POP3/IMAP/SMTP/Exchange/CardDAV service”, verify as prompted, then click “Generate authorization code” and paste the 16-character code above.
netease_code_steps: Servers fill in automatically. The password is an authorization code (授权码), not your sign-in password: open NetEase Mail on the web, go to Settings › POP3/SMTP/IMAP and turn on “IMAP/SMTP service”. After you verify with your phone as prompted, the code is shown: paste it above.
qq_open_web: Open QQ Mail on the web
netease_open_web: Open NetEase Mail on the web
smtp_tls: SMTP uses STARTTLS on 587 and SSL on other ports.
use_inbox_detail: DMs, @mentions, group messages, and mentions in Docs. AI sorts them first and drafts replies
use_knowledge_detail: Chats, people, groups, and projects are archived as context for the assistant and AI twin
use_assistant_detail: Persona can search messages and read docs. It asks on your phone before sending messages or making other changes
use_agent_detail: Start a message with /agent anywhere in Lark to have an agent handle it and reply for you
account_quarantined: Can't open. Retry or remove it in the Lark gateway
lark_footer_unconfigured: The hub isn't connected to Lark yet. Run the Lark gateway on the hub machine and add it under lark in the assistant's manager.json (docs/extensions/feishu.md).
lark_footer: Lark accounts sign in through the Lark gateway on the hub machine. This only shows the connection status.
accounts_note: All signed-in accounts feed the Inbox, and you can switch accounts on the Messages page. /agent, the assistant, and the knowledge base use the default account. Add or sign out of accounts in the Lark gateway.
outlook_body: Personal Outlook / Hotmail and work Microsoft 365 mailboxes use Sign in with Microsoft, not a password. After you authorize, Microsoft returns to the Persona app on your iPhone, which the web can't receive. On your phone, open Settings › Connectors › Mail › Add account › Outlook. Once it's added, it shows up here and in the Inbox.
outlook_ready: This hub has a client ID for Outlook sign-in
outlook_register_intro: Outlook sign-in uses an app you register in Microsoft Entra yourself (free, once; this hub keeps using it). You can enter it here, then sign in on your phone:
outlook_step1: Open entra.microsoft.com with your Microsoft account, then App registrations › New registration.
outlook_step2: For supported account types, pick accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts.
outlook_step3: For the redirect URI, pick Public client/native (mobile & desktop) and enter the callback below.
outlook_step4: Under Authentication, set Allow public client flows to Yes.
outlook_step5: Under API permissions, add IMAP.AccessAsUser.All and SMTP.Send (delegated).
outlook_step6: Enter the Application (client) ID from the Overview page below.
client_id_saved: Client ID saved. Sign in to Outlook on your phone.
outlook_config_failed: Couldn't read the Outlook sign-in settings: {error}
